title: A preferred OEM partner for orthodontic brands worldwide.
lede: We've built our OEM business on the same things our own product line is judged on: product quality, end-to-end production control, and the ability to customise to a partner's exact specification — backed by an in-house tooling facility that keeps every step under one roof.

sections.heading: What our OEM service covers
paragraphs: Our OEM work specialises in high-volume, labour-intensive operations: assembly line production, inspection, final packaging, custom labelling and shipping, all under the same roof as our own tooling facility. That single-site setup is what lets us hold consistent quality across every product we manufacture, for our own catalogue and for partner brands alike.

Orthodontist feedback from across the more than 40 countries we ship to has shaped that production discipline over time, and our R&D team continues working to shorten turnaround on every new OEM project.

capabilityGrid.title: Production Flexibility
capabilityGrid.description: Direct input into production design rather than a fixed catalogue of options.

capabilityGrid.title: Direct Access to Leadership
capabilityGrid.description: Communication with senior management, not layers of account management.

capabilityGrid.title: Real-Time Schedule Visibility
capabilityGrid.description: Live updates on where your production run actually stands.

capabilityGrid.title: Packaging Freedom
capabilityGrid.description: Custom labelling and packaging built around your brand, not ours.

sections.heading: The cost case for partnering with us
paragraphs: Beyond product quality, OEM partners typically see savings across several parts of their operation at once:

capabilityGrid.title: Lower In-House Overhead
capabilityGrid.description: Reduced or eliminated need for your own assembly and packaging staff.

capabilityGrid.title: Lower Warehousing Cost
capabilityGrid.description: Less inventory sitting in your own facility waiting to be assembled.

capabilityGrid.title: Lower Transport Cost
capabilityGrid.description: Fewer shipping legs between raw material, assembly and final delivery.

capabilityGrid.title: Centralised Control
capabilityGrid.description: One manufacturing location accountable for the full production run.

faqs.question: How long has Modern Orthodontics worked as an OEM manufacturer?
faqs.answer: Over 20 years, alongside our own product line, specialising in high-volume orthodontic hardware production.

faqs.question: Can OEM partners customise packaging and labelling?
faqs.answer: Yes — custom labelling, packaging and assembly are part of the core OEM service, not an add-on.

faqs.question: Will I have a single point of contact for an OEM project?
faqs.answer: Partnering with us means direct communication with senior management and real-time visibility into your production schedule, rather than working through multiple account layers.

faqs.question: What cost savings can an OEM partner expect?
faqs.answer: Most partners see reduced in-house assembly and warehouse staffing needs, lower transport costs from centralised production, and tighter inventory control overall.

seo.description: OEM manufacturing, assembly, inspection, custom labelling and packaging for orthodontic industry partners worldwide.
